name: core
description: The teaching entry point for the plugin-rnd-lab marketplace. Explains both stages in plain language — Prospector (discovery: what is worth building at all) and Optimizer (A/B measurement: does it actually help) — how they chain via a pre-written mandate, and why the dod-lite auditor is a separate plugin. Ships no workflow steps and writes no files: it is a walkthrough and reference skill, invoked by the user, never auto-triggered mid-task.
